//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"syscall/js"

	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/offline"
)

// This mutex guards only Go ownership/state transitions. No host operation,
// callback, notification, cancellation or refresh activity utility runs under it.
// Production doc/win identities are initialized before offline exposure.
var offlineAuthorityMu sync.Mutex

type offlineOperationAuthority struct {
	c *offlineController
	descriptor offline.ClientDescriptor
	document, window js.Value
}

// Identity/tag operations on js.Value are Go operations; this helper never
// reads a foreign property. The caller owns offlineAuthorityMu.
func offlineCurrentAuthorityLocked(c *offlineController, descriptor offline.ClientDescriptor, document, window js.Value) bool {
	return c != nil && documentOffline == c && c.state.Configured && c.state.Supported && c.busy &&
		c.descriptor == descriptor && doc.Equal(document) && win.Equal(window)
}

func offlineOperationPhase(command string) (string, OfflineDiagnosticOperation) {
	switch command {
	case "status": return "checking", OfflineDiagnosticStatus
	case "enable": return "enabling", OfflineDiagnosticEnable
	case "update": return "updating", OfflineDiagnosticUpdate
	case "disable": return "disabling", OfflineDiagnosticDisable
	}
	return "", OfflineDiagnosticOperationUnknown
}

// ctx is the internal WithTimeout context created by offlineOperation, never
// an arbitrary caller implementation. Its final Err read linearizes admission.
func offlineAdmitOperation(ctx context.Context, command string) (offlineOperationAuthority, error) {
	phase, op := offlineOperationPhase(command)
	if phase == "" { return offlineOperationAuthority{}, ErrOfflineProtocol }
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	defer offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	c := documentOffline
	if c == nil || !c.state.Configured { return offlineOperationAuthority{}, ErrOfflineUnavailable }
	if !c.state.Supported { return offlineOperationAuthority{}, ErrOfflineUnsupported }
	if c.busy || offlineRealmInUse != nil { return offlineOperationAuthority{}, ErrOfflineBusy }
	a := offlineOperationAuthority{c:c, descriptor:c.descriptor, document:doc, window:win}
	if ctx.Err() != nil { return offlineOperationAuthority{}, ErrOfflineUnknown }
	c.busy = true
	c.conflictReason = ""
	c.state.Phase, c.state.LastError = phase, ""
	if command == "disable" { c.lastDisable = offlineDisableReceipt{} }
	c.diag = offlineDiagnosticBeginLocked(c.diag, op, a.descriptor.RuntimeID, a.descriptor.ConfigurationID)
	return a, nil
}

// Validation and browser/facet support evaluation must precede this call.
// A slow initializer can never configure a replacement controller.
func offlineCommitConfigurationLocked(c *offlineController, descriptor offline.ClientDescriptor, supported bool) bool {
	if c == nil || documentOffline != c { return false }
	c.descriptor = descriptor
	c.state.Configured, c.state.Supported = true, supported
	c.state.Scope, c.state.OwnerPolicyID = descriptor.Scope, descriptor.OwnerPolicyID
	if supported { c.state.Phase = "checking" }
	return true
}

func (a offlineOperationAuthority) currentLocked(ctx context.Context) bool {
	return offlineCurrentAuthorityLocked(a.c,a.descriptor,a.document,a.window) && ctx.Err() == nil
}

func (a offlineOperationAuthority) apply(ctx context.Context, reply offlineReply) bool {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	defer offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if !a.currentLocked(ctx) { return false }
	a.c.applyLocked(reply)
	return true
}

// Increment and owner snapshot precede all formatting/channel/native work.
func (c *offlineController) reserveOfflineRequest() (uint64, string, error) {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	defer offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if c.request == ^uint64(0) { return 0, "", ErrOfflineProtocol }
	c.request++
	return c.request, c.descriptor.OwnerPolicyID, nil
}
